title: discovery.rs and peer_fetch.rs both build TailnetCertVerifier singletons independently
description: discovery.rs defines TailnetCertVerifier and a PROBE_CLIENT OnceLock singleton. peer_fetch.rs re-uses TailnetCertVerifier (imported from discovery.rs) but maintains a separate TAILNET_CLIENT OnceLock singleton. Both clients use the same TailnetCertVerifier logic but different OnceLock instances. There is no sharing between probe connections and blob-fetch connections. This is architecturally fine (different use cases) but the two OnceLock patterns with near-identical builder functions (build_probe_client vs build_tailnet_https_client) could confuse a future contributor. Consider consolidating into a single shared tailnet client.
